pages.learnerAction: Listen to the can-do, then read the lesson title aloud once.

pages.articleTreatment: Not applicable; this page introduces the goal only.

pages.learnerAction: Ask any question left from pre-study; otherwise continue to the live discussion.
pages.tutorAction: Answer a learner question briefly, or skip the article entirely if there is no question or no pre-study.

pages.learningTarget: Use the optional pre-study article to seed ideas and vocabulary without turning class into a reading lesson.
pages.pedagogicalValue: Supplies several positions and examples that can make later answers more specific while remaining optional.
pages.failureDiagnosis: No article question is not a failure; difficulty explaining a highlighted word identifies a lexical support need only.
pages.nonTargetSupport: The full article uses natural B2–C1 clauses and two relevant glosses; every sentence has Japanese support and only relevant blockers are glossed.

pages.choiceQuality: Sentence reveals are informational supports, not graded choices or distractors.

pages.learnerAction: Choose discussion-first or correction-first for today’s conversation.

pages.failureDiagnosis: No language failure is diagnosed; the selection records a lesson preference.
pages.nonTargetSupport: Japanese choice labels explain the two modes, while tutor-only bullets specify the operational difference.
pages.articleTreatment: Not applicable; this page controls discussion style.
pages.choiceQuality: The two options are mutually exclusive and meaningfully different: delayed essential correction versus correction at natural breaks.

pages.learnerAction: Listen to how the question pool will be used, then begin the conversation.
pages.tutorAction: Use the pages as a flexible pool: react or share briefly, follow interesting details, skip freely, and reserve feedback time.
pages.targetOrPrompt: We don't need to answer every question. Let's follow the most interesting parts of your answers. 全部の質問に答える必要はありません。答えの中でいちばん面白いところを広げていきましょう。
pages.learningTarget: Frame the activity as reciprocal conversation rather than eight questions to complete in order.
pages.pedagogicalValue: Protects depth, tutor reciprocity, and natural follow-up over superficial page completion.
pages.failureDiagnosis: No language failure is tested; a rigid interview-like flow would indicate the tutor has not followed the operating note.
pages.nonTargetSupport: The Japanese line explicitly says not every question is required and that interesting answer details should guide the talk.
pages.articleTreatment: Not applicable; the article has already been handled or skipped.
pages.choiceQuality: No choices or distractors; this is an operating transition.
pages.componentConsistency: Matches the approved FT question-pool transition with visible flexibility and a concrete tutor-only reciprocity note.
